csv_project_name: AE for William P Clements State Office Building Renovations
csv_scope_of_work: The project consists of renovations of the existing restrooms, adding additional restrooms, and renovations of the existing breakrooms on floors 1-12 and 14. The renovations will include upgrading the existing sanitary sewer lines on floors 1-12 and 14. The project is located within the William P. Clements State Office Building located at 300 W 15th St., Austin Texas. 2) Approximate cost of construction for the aforementioned list of projects is estimated to be fourteen million dollars ($14,000,000). Provide professional architectural and engineering services for the Project. Services shall include but not be limited to Design (Schematic Design, Design Development, and Construction Documents), Bidding, Construction Administration, and Closeout. Attend and participate in all meetings with TFC and all relevant state agencies, on-site meetings, coordination meetings with local utility providers, and with other local municipal departments as required. 3.1. Phase 1: Architectural and Engineering scope of services shall include, but not be limited to, the following: a) Detailed on-site investigations, review of existing documents, verify and validate items in existing deficiencies list requested for correction. Deficiency list will be provided to the final selected firm. b) A list of necessary testing and inspections to be provided to Owner including, but not limited to, ADA, Commissioning, and Testing and Balancing. c) Assistance in evaluation and interview of Construction Manager-at-Risk selection. d) Assistance to Construction Manager-at-Risk to prepare order-of-magnitude cost estimates for correction of deficiencies by repair or replacement, as recommended by the AE. Assistance in developing priorities for adjusting scope of work to match available funding. e) Research, evaluate, and present to the Owner any energy conservation strategies and alternatives for consideration, including the availability of rebates from the local utility. If rebates are available, coordinate with the local utility to complete all necessary documentation to accomplish rebates. f) Presentation of findings to Owner for review and approval. Upon acceptance of Phase 1 findings, and authorization by Owner, proceed with Phase 2. 3.2. Phase 2: Architecture and Engineering scope of services shall include, but not be limited to, the following: a) Detailed design and documentation of construction plans and specifications. b) Provide the Owner with a list of items to be tested and/or inspected including, but not limited to, ADA, Commissioning, Testing and Balancing, Environmental, and Construction Materials testing. c) Coordinate with third party commissioning agent throughout design and construction administration. d) Assist Construction Manager-at-Risk during subcontractor solicitation for development of Guaranteed Maximum Price. e) Construction Administration. f) Warranty management. g) Project closeout. 3.3. Architecture and Engineering scope of services shall include, but not be limited to, the following: A/E services shall be offered with the understanding of full compliance with non-discrimination requirements of the State of Texas by the A/E.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Construction/Project Management, Materials Testing, Mechanical Engineering

title: A/E Services for Renovations of the William P. Clements State Office Building
short_description: Renovation of restrooms, breakrooms, and sanitary lines in a state office building.
project_location: William P. Clements State Office Building, 300 W 15th St., Austin, Texas, USA
project_scope: Renovation project in an existing state office building covering floors 1-12 and 14. Scope includes renovation of existing restrooms, addition of new restrooms, renovation of existing breakrooms, and upgrades to existing sanitary sewer lines on the affected floors. Phase 1 includes detailed site investigations, review of existing documents, deficiency validation, testing and inspection planning, cost-estimate support, and evaluation of energy conservation strategies. Phase 2 includes detailed design, construction documents, testing/inspection coordination, support for GMP development, construction administration, warranty management, and closeout.
services: Professional architectural and engineering services including schematic design, design development, construction documents, bidding, construction administration, and closeout; detailed investigations; interior design/space planning; rehabilitation and refurbishment; assistance with CM-at-Risk selection and GMP development; coordination of ADA, commissioning, testing and balancing, environmental and materials testing; warranty management.
relevance_explanation:
- Existing administrative/state office building renovation, which is generally low priority for sbp.
- Scope focuses on interior renovations, sanitary lines, and breakrooms/restrooms rather than structural or special engineering challenges.
- No bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or complex load-bearing system indicated.
- Includes A/E design phases and construction administration, but the technical profile is mainly architectural/interior refurbishment.
- Some sustainability aspect through energy conservation strategies, but not enough to materially increase relevance.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the tender documents. Available fee-related basis: total construction cost is 14,000,000 USD; services include full A/E design from schematic design through closeout, plus investigations and construction administration.
references_qualifications: Bidders are to provide professional architectural and engineering services with requested disciplines including architecture, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, construction/project management, materials testing, and mechanical engineering. Full compliance with State of Texas non-discrimination requirements is required. No specific number or type of reference projects is stated in the provided text.
